info.title: HiringPizza Workforce API
info.description: Workflow-first API for workforce management. Employee operations are store-scoped by store number. Global catalog endpoints are not store-scoped.

get.description: Returns a unified paginated feed across hiring, separation, and milestone gift workflows. Each item contains a `request_type` field (`separation`, `hiring`, or `milestone_gift`) and a matching typed object (`separation_request`, `hiring_request`, or `milestone_gift_request`); the other two are always `null`. get.summary: List milestone gift questions for the store
get.description: Returns all **active** questions visible to this store: global questions (`store_id=null`) plus any questions created specifically for this store, ordered by `sort_order`. Call this endpoint before rendering the Stage 2 rating form to know which questions and options to display. Management of questions (create/update/delete) is done via the global `/v1/milestone-gift-questions` endpoints below.

get.summary: List all milestone gift questions (global management)
get.description: Returns **all** questions — global and store-specific, active and inactive — ordered by `sort_order`. Use this endpoint in admin/management UIs when building the question editor. Each question includes its options and a `store_id` field (`null` = global, integer = store-specific). To see only the questions available to a particular store's rating form, use `GET /v1/stores/{storeNumber}/milestone-gift-questions` instead.

post.summary: Create a milestone gift question (global management)
post.description:
Creates a new rating question. This is a **global** management endpoint — no store prefix in the URL.

**Scope:**
- Omit `store_id` or send `null` → question is **global** and will appear for every store's rating form.
- Send a valid `store_id` → question is **store-specific** and will only appear in that store's rating form.

**Validation:** `store_id` must be `null` or an existing store ID. It cannot be an arbitrary value.

`question_type`:
- `single_select` — reviewer must pick exactly one option.
- `multi_select` — reviewer may pick one or more options.

value.question_text: How would you rate this employee's attendance?
Does this employee speak Spanish fluently?

post.description:
## Workflow Overview

The milestone gift workflow has the following stages:

```
created → rating → gift_decision → final_status → closed
                               ↘ cancelled
```

**Stage 1 (this endpoint):** The manager creates a ticket by selecting an employee and the gift milestone. This moves the request to stage `created`.

**Stage 2** (`POST /{id}/rating`): Rating questions are answered. Moves to `rating`.

**Stage 3** (`POST /{id}/gift-decision`): Gift details are recorded or the ticket is cancelled. Moves to `gift_decision` or `cancelled`.

**Stage 4** (`POST /{id}/final-status`): Delivery status is set and optionally the ticket is closed. Moves to `final_status` or `closed`. Can be called again to switch status.

404.description: Store or employee not found / employee not in store

post.description:
Submits answers to all active milestone gift questions for this store. The request must currently be in stage `created`.

**answers** is an array with one entry per question. For `single_select` questions pass a single integer in `option_ids`. For `multi_select` questions pass an array of integers.

Fetch the current question list first via `GET /v1/stores/{storeNumber}/milestone-gift-questions`.

Moves the ticket to stage `rating`.

404.description: Request not found in this store

post.summary: Stage 3 — Record gift decision or cancel
post.description:
Records what gift was sent (or cancels the ticket). The request must currently be in stage `rating` or `gift_decision` (re-submitting updates the existing decision).

**To cancel:** send `is_cancelled: true` with an optional `cancellation_reason`. Stage moves to `cancelled`.

**To record a gift:** send `is_cancelled: false` with `gift_description`, `gift_cost`, `delivery_date`, and optionally `sent_to_store`. Stage moves to `gift_decision`.

Calling this endpoint again while in `gift_decision` is valid — it updates the decision (e.g., to flip `sent_to_store` once the gift ships).

update_sent.summary: Mark gift as sent to store

value.cancellation_reason: Employee left before gift was arranged.

get.description:
Returns the same four dashboard sections as the single-store reports endpoint (`manager-dashboard`, `high-hours-employees`, `average-hourly-pay`, `weekly-labor`) but for multiple stores over an explicit date range in a single call.

**Store selection:** Pass `stores[]=101&stores[]=102` for specific stores, or `stores[]=all` to include every store.

**Date range:** `start_date` and `end_date` are used directly as metric window boundaries (inclusive). Weekly-labor entries are bucketed into Tuesday–Monday business weeks within the range.

**Full details:** The `average-hourly-pay` section returns one row per employee (pay, hours, tips, labor) rather than store-level aggregates. All other sections match the single-store equivalents.

The response is a plain object keyed by store number.

parameters.name: stores[]
parameters.description: One or more store numbers, e.g. `stores[]=101&stores[]=102`. Pass `stores[]=all` to include every store.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Range start date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Range end date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Must be on or after start_date.

200.description: Report data keyed by store number

422.description: Validation error — missing or invalid parameters

post.summary: Stage 4 — Set final delivery status (and optionally close)
post.description:
Sets or updates the final gift delivery status. The request must be in stage `gift_decision`, `final_status`, or `closed`.

**Status options:**
- `delivered_to_employee` — Gift handed directly to the employee.
- `sent_to_store_awaiting_pickup` — Gift shipped to the store; employee hasn't picked it up yet.
- `not_delivered_no_longer_with_company` — Employee left; gift was not delivered.
- `not_delivered_other_reason` — Gift not delivered for another reason (requires `status_other_reason`).

For each status you must supply a `confirmation_date`.

This endpoint can be called **multiple times** to switch between statuses (e.g., from `sent_to_store_awaiting_pickup` to `delivered_to_employee` once the employee picks it up). Each call updates the single status record — there is no history of status changes.

**To close the ticket:** include `"close": true`. The ticket moves to stage `closed` and `closing_notes` (optional) are recorded. A closed ticket's status can still be updated by calling this endpoint again.

200.description: Final status set (stage: final_status or closed)
